shell.settingsSubtitle: Browse settings by category and parameter group
settings.resetWarning: Waveform, display, sound, alarm, vital sign and language settings will return to their defaults. Unapplied edits and sweep history will be cleared, and monitor sound will be disabled. This cannot be undone.
settings.resetDone: All defaults restored and simulation restarted.
settings.delayHelp: Enter 0–60 seconds. Arrow keys adjust by 0.1 seconds.
settings.applyTip: Apply after the selected delay and preserve sweep history.
settings.restartTip: Apply settings, clear sweep history and restart.
settings.resetTip: Restore all defaults, including waveform, display, sound, alarms and language; clear current history.
settings.languageSaveFailed: Language changed, but could not be saved. Check write access to the settings folder; the previous language may return after restart.
settings.languageRejected: The language preference could not be restored; Simplified Chinese was selected.
settings.recoveryNotice: Some local preferences could not be restored; affected settings use defaults.
settings.recoveryStatus: Some local preferences could not be restored. Apply valid settings to save them again.
settings.preferenceSaveFailed: Could not save preferences; changes are active for this run.
settings.preferenceSaveWarning: Could not save preferences. These changes will not be retained after restart.
settings.restarted: Restarted with the startup transition removed and the 12-lead snapshot updated.
settings.scheduled: Scheduled for simulation time {0:0.0} s. History and measurement windows are preserved; the sweep follows about 2.2 seconds later. Pausing stops the countdown; applying again replaces the pending settings.
settings.applied: Applied at simulation time {0:0.0} s. History and measurement windows are preserved; the sweep continues through the acquisition buffer.
settings.generationFailed: Generation failed and was paused. Check settings before restarting.
display.skin: Monitor layout and fixed row count
display.rowSpeed: Row {0} sweep speed, relative millimeters per second
validation.baselineRestart: Patient data or oxygenation baseline changed. Select Restart to apply them. The current simulation and pending settings are unchanged.
validation.applyDelay: Not applied: apply delay must be 0–60 seconds in 0.1-second steps. The current simulation and pending settings are unchanged.
validation.sound: Not applied or saved: check volume, source, pause duration and alarm intervals on the Sound page. The current waveform session is unchanged.
validation.notification: Not applied or saved: correct the mode or timing under Alarms → Notification policy. The current simulation is unchanged.
validation.alarmLimits: Not applied or saved: complete enabled alarm limits in this order: Critical low < Warning low < Warning high < Critical high. SpO₂ requires Critical low < Warning low. The CO₂ no-breath timeout must be 5–120 seconds. Check the Alarms page. The waveform session is unchanged.
validation.seed: Not applied: the shared seed requires 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters (0–9, a–f). Generate one under Vital signs → Random seed. The current simulation and display are unchanged.
validation.cardiacRate: Not applied: heart-rate adjustment requires the sinus reference with 1:1 conduction. Disable adjustment under Vital signs → Heart rate, or select a compatible template. The simulation and display are unchanged.
validation.co2Range: Not applied: the end-tidal CO₂ target plus or minus variation must stay within 5–80 mmHg. Adjust the target or variation under Vital signs → Respiration and CO₂. The simulation and display are unchanged.
validation.co2Regular: Not applied: breath-to-breath CO₂ variation requires regular breathing. Set variation to 0 under Vital signs → Respiration and CO₂, or select regular breathing. The simulation and display are unchanged.
validation.co2Levels: Not applied: CO₂ baseline must be an integer from 0–80 mmHg and the end-tidal target from 5–80 mmHg. Plateau start must lie between them, with at most two decimal places. The simulation and display are unchanged.
validation.co2Baseline: Not applied: breath-to-breath CO₂ variation requires a zero baseline. Set baseline to 0 or disable variation. The simulation and display are unchanged.
validation.co2Timing: Not applied: CO₂ dead-space, rise and fall durations must be integers from 1–10000 ms and fit the current breathing cycle. The simulation and display are unchanged.
validation.co2Response: Not applied: CO₂ transport delay must be an integer from 0–5000 ms and dispersion step from 0–500 ms. The simulation and display are unchanged.
validation.respirationSignal: Not applied: RESP amplitude must be an integer from −1000–1000 and cardiac artifact from −200–200. The simulation and display are unchanged.
validation.qrs: Not applied: check QRS morphology, mixing ratio and integer ST/T component values. The simulation and display are unchanged.
validation.infarctionLead: Not applied: select at least one chest lead for the infarction snapshot. The simulation and display are unchanged.
validation.repolarization: Not applied: regional repolarization delay must be an integer from 0–500 ms and fit the cardiac cycle. The simulation and display are unchanged.
validation.waveLead: Not applied: select at least one chest lead for the T-wave target. The simulation and display are unchanged.
validation.oxygenFlow: Not applied: inspiratory flow exceeds the oxygenation prototype range. Reduce VT or increase inspiration duration. The simulation is unchanged.
validation.configuration: Not applied: check templates, vital signs, seed and ranges. Heart-rate adjustment requires the sinus reference with 1:1 conduction; CO₂ variation requires regular breathing. The simulation and display are unchanged.
validation.oxygenDisabled: Enable the two-wavelength pulse-oximetry teaching source and real-time oxygenation model, then apply settings.
validation.ventilationFlow: Ventilation not updated: flow exceeds the prototype range. Reduce VT or increase inspiration duration.
validation.ventilationParameters: Invalid ventilation or oxygen-consumption parameters. Check VT, VD, FiO₂ and the oxygen-consumption multiplier. The simulation is unchanged.
settings.ventilationScheduled: Ventilation and oxygen consumption will take effect at simulation time {0:0.000} s; baseline {1:0.###} × {2:0.##} = {3:0.###} mL O₂/min. Oxygen reserves, baseline and measurement windows are preserved.
validation.vitalValue: Not applied: enter a valid {0}. The simulation and display are unchanged.
validation.breathingDetail: Not applied: {0} The simulation and display are unchanged.
validation.patientDetail: Not applied: {0} The simulation is unchanged.
settings.statusIdle: Apply continues the current waveform; Restart clears the sweep history.
settings.templateSelected: Selected {0}. The preview is updated; running data changes only after you apply.
settings.pageDefaultsRestored: Restored the {0} defaults. Not applied yet; the running simulation is unchanged.
